faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the RBI Medical Consultant posts is 05-10-2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Consultant position will receive a salary of Rs. 1400 per hour. This is a contractual role, and the payment is structured on an hourly basis.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualification requirements for this role?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a Medical Council of India recognized university, a Post Graduate Degree in General Medicine, and a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Medical Consultant position in the Reserve Bank of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the RBI Medical Consultant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Consultant post involves an Interview, followed by a Medical Examination and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected Medical Consultant be posted?
faq.answer: The Medical Consultant will be posted in Patna, Bihar. The pincode for the location is 800001.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for the Medical Consultant position.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates are required to download the application form and submit it as per the guidelines provided in the official notification.
